body:
Thanks for reporting, @pliusnin!

I confirm it's reproducible in the ecommerce example and also in here: (https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/doc-code-samples/tree/master/InstantSearch.js/routing-seo-friendly) (for our reference).
And, it doesn't happen when `routing: true` is given to instantsearch().

I'll keep you updated.
